items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: And Louis Caravello on drums. ... Sometimes he comes out of height and sits in with us.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, maybe I got a picture up in here. Yeah. Keep talking, I'll find a picture.

And then I also played at the spotlight across the street from the famous Dill. We used to make it down at half the night and tips there. Hmm. Yeah. See, there was another band I also played with. That was with Jill Clessie, Tweety, Francis Murray. And Louis Caravello on drums. He's now playing bass. He's working for the railroad. Sometimes he comes out of height and sits in with us. Sometimes on the drums, sometimes on the bass. At Lodgins, huh? Yeah, let's see.
Here's a picture of Raymond Rogers. Yes. That's the one they call Wiffle? No.
